name: tech-priests
title: Tech Priests
author: christopher vardeman
description: Bring the Adeptus Mechanicus to Factorio with Tech-Priests who repair, supply and expand your factory. Coordinate them through Cogitator Stations, tend machine spirits, and defend your industry with bunkers, heavy weapons and combat units. Build a metallic hydrogen fuel industry and plasma reactors. Space Age adds Void Priests, fusion thrusters, shields and shipboard weapons.
